name: Alma Hybrid

card.summary: A clinic laser platform from Alma Lasers for fractional skin resurfacing, used to improve texture, scars, wrinkles and sun damage.
card.note: Professional procedure; resurfacing lasers can cause scarring, pigment changes and herpes flare-ups.

quick.overview:
Alma Hybrid is a laser resurfacing system made by Alma Lasers, positioned for skin rejuvenation in clinics. Laser resurfacing in general treats wrinkles, sun damage, scars and stretch marks by heating the deep dermis, which stimulates fibroblasts to form new collagen and elastin.
Fractional lasers treat many tiny points and leave healthy skin between them, which is described as safer than older full-surface lasers. No specific published trials of the Alma Hybrid exist.
quick.how: Treatments are performed by clinicians in-office; ablative lasers vaporise tissue in controlled wounds while non-ablative ones leave the skin surface intact. Recovery and the number of sessions vary by settings and clinic.
quick.risks: Resurfacing lasers can cause scarring, hyperpigmentation, acne and herpes outbreaks, according to Wikipedia. Complications were reported in a study of 961 fractional treatments.

lead: Alma Hybrid is a laser platform from Alma Lasers used by clinicians for skin resurfacing and rejuvenation.

Laser resurfacing is used to treat wrinkles, sun damage, age spots and scars. Heating the deep dermis stimulates fibroblasts to form new collagen and elastin, which improves skin texture over time.[1] Ablative systems, such as 10,600 nm CO2 and 2940 nm Er:YAG lasers, vaporise tissue; non-ablative systems, such as 1540 nm Er:glass, keep the surface intact.[1]

Fractional systems deliver many pinpoints of laser energy and leave healthy skin between them. Wikipedia describes erbium and CO2 fractional systems as safer than older lasers, though complications such as acne and herpes outbreaks occurred in a study of 961 treatments.[1]

chain: Fractional laser energy delivered to skin
New collagen and smoother skin over time
angle.text: People use resurfacing lasers to smooth wrinkles, scars and sun-damaged skin. The treatment works by prompting the skin to rebuild collagen.

paras: Laser resurfacing uses controlled heating of the dermis to trigger collagen and elastin production.[1] Fractional delivery leaves untreated skin between points, which supports healing.[1]

Reported complications of laser resurfacing include scarring, hyperpigmentation, acne and herpes outbreaks.[1] CO2 laser resurfacing was reported to carry higher risk of hypopigmentation and scarring than erbium.[1]
No studies of the Alma Hybrid specifically have been found. Studies of fractional laser resurfacing in general are summarised in the Wikipedia article on laser resurfacing.[1]
